title: CRLR/38/2005 of RAVINDRA KUMAR Vs STATE and 2 ORS.

paras.text:
CRLR No. 38 of 2005
Hon'ble U.C. Dhyani, J.

Ms. Sheetal, Advocate holding
brief of Mr. Arvind Kumar Sharma,
Advocate for the revisionist.
 Ms. Mamta Bisht, AGA for the
respondent State.
 Learned counsel for the
revisionist submitted that since the
parties have settled their dispute
amicably out of court, this criminal
revision has become infructuous.
 In view of the above statement,
the criminal revision is dismissed as
infructous.
